title: Full-Length Practice Test Strategy
tagline: Year 4 — Planning a series of full-length mocks: spacing, timing, conditions, review time and a taper before the real test

introduction.overview: Full-length practice tests build stamina and test your plan under real conditions. How you use them matters: take them under real timing and conditions, review each one for as long as it took to attempt (or longer), space them so that review and specific practice fit in between, and taper in the last days. This chapter works through the arithmetic of a schedule and gives a checklist for each mock. The figures in this chapter's examples are illustrative and not real test statistics.
introduction.placementRelevance: A planned series of mocks beats an ad-hoc pile of mocks.
introduction.realWorldContext: Rehearsals before an important event follow the same pattern.

learningObjectives: Plan the number and spacing of mocks

prerequisiteKnowledge.quickRefresher: Review time should be at least equal to attempt time.

coreDefinitions: Full-length mock: a complete test under timed conditions.
Real conditions: same timing, device and rules.
Review ratio: review time ÷ test time.
Taper: lighter practice just before the real test.
conceptExplanation.theoreticalIntuition: A mock tests the plan; the review improves it.
conceptExplanation.visualOrMentalModel: Schedule mocks, protect review time, compare trends, taper at the end.

mainNarrative: Suppose you have 4 weeks and take 2 full mocks a week: 8 mocks, one every 3.5 days.
A 65-minute mock plus an equal review is 130 minutes; 8 such mocks take 17.3 hours.
Keep real conditions: same time of day, device and rules as the real test.
Compare accuracy across mocks: 58%, 62%, 66%, 70%: a rise of 4 points per mock.
In the last two days do light revision and sleep rather than a new mock.

deepDiveAspects.title: Quality over quantity
deepDiveAspects.content: Two analysed mocks are worth more than four unanalysed.

deepDiveAspects.title: Simulate pressure
deepDiveAspects.content: Practise with a visible timer and no pauses.
